pages.text: Dad shaped tree bark into a tiny boat. Its sail was one leaf.
"I'll send this boat to the waterwheel pool." Mumu gently set it by the water.
Dodo put a wing behind it. "Push hard, and boats go far. I know!" "Then just once!" Mumu turned the bow for her.
Dodo gave it a hard push.
The boat plunged nosefirst into the water. Over it rolled, floating upside down.
"It was pretending to be a dolphin, right?" Dodo lifted it out and shook off water.
Mumu watched the current. One leaf drifted all by itself toward the pool.
Mumu placed the boat lightly on the water and took his wing away.
The current gently carried the boat along. Mumu walked beside it on the bank path.
The boat floated into the waterwheel pool. "Arrived!" Dodo brought fresh bark. "The next boat will be named Dodo!" The little boat made one turn in the pool.
